track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 30: Reng-e Shahr-ashub
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Reng-e Shahr-ashub in Chahargah, Shur. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on E4 and dwells most on A in Reng-e Shahr-ashub. The line peaks at Fs4 (359.3 Hz) at 0:33.1. It closes on the tonic (Fs4 → E4 → Fs4 → E3 → A2 → A3).
